verdict.rationale: Vercel documents its own access to both build and runtime logs: a Logs overview covering runtime logs, CLI log retrieval, and official MCP tools for deployment build logs and runtime logs/errors, all exposed through one server interface. However, no evidence shows a single unified dashboard view combining build, deploy, and runtime logs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a single consolidated log view spanning build, deploy and runtime; deploy-event logs specifically; hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can view all my build, deploy, and runtime logs in one place

citations.quote: Use `errorsOnly` to return only failing lines
For longer log storage, you can use Log Drains.
